title: Todoist MCP HTTP server permits browser DNS rebinding
summary: A malicious website can rebind its origin to the local HTTP MCP server and invoke Todoist tools using the server-held API key, including write and delete operations.

severity.rationale: The attack needs optional HTTP mode and a malicious browser page. Documented impact is access to one connected Todoist service, including destructive data changes.

exposure: The optional todoist-mcp-http entrypoint must be running while an untrusted page is open. The stdio entrypoint is not browser-reachable.

params.instructions: Check @doist/todoist-mcp version and whether the documented exposure conditions apply.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.risk: Medium. Updates can interrupt workflows and require compatibility checks.

verification: Confirm the deployed component uses the patched release and test the affected workflow with harmless inputs.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.
